entries.test: Contemporary coverage of GPT-5's August 2025 launch, including reports of widespread user and expert disappointment and backlash.
entries.note: Only the part about widespread disappointment can be graded. 'Arguably among the most overhyped products in history' is hedged opinion.

entries.test: Whether frontier LLM benchmark performance stopped improving materially between early 2024 and January 2026, and the number and scale of lawsuits pending against OpenAI as of January 2026.
entries.note: This combines two claims. The litigation part is easy to check, but 'plateau' is contested, and benchmark scores kept rising through 2025.

entries.test: Whether OpenAI announced plans to allow erotica in ChatGPT and whether its executives publicly floated government backstops or bailouts in late 2025.
entries.note: What he commits to is the facts. 'Small wonder' is framing, not a testable causal claim, so the motive behind these moves is not graded.
